**The New Gold Standard in Immersive Industrial Training.**

Welcome to Zeal X, the next-gen XR learning platform from the award-winning team at GRAHAs VR. Zeal X bridges the gap between theory and practice using our proprietary STEP Framework™ (Story, Emotion, Place) to ensure zero-risk skill acquisition.
Single line break 

🔴 AVAILABLE NOW: Electrical Safety (LOTO)
Step onto a virtual factory floor to master critical Lockout/Tagout procedures. Designed for professionals, this module features:

⚡ Hazard ID & PPE: Identify risks and select the correct gear.

🔒 LOTO Execution: Perform compliant isolation sequences.

🔋 Voltage Verification: Verify "Zero Energy State" with realistic tools.

✋ Hand Tracking: No controllers needed. Use real hands to flip switches and handle tools. 

🛡️ Standards Aligned: Designed to reflect OSHA 1910.269 and NFPA 70E workflows for High Voltage safety, covering critical LOTO, PPE selection, and Grounding procedures.

🔵 COMING SOON
A growing library of modules including Fire Safety, Crane Operations, and Sterile Healthcare Protocols.

🏢 FOR ENTERPRISE DEPLOYMENT
Upgrade to the Zeal X Enterprise License to unlock the platform's full power:

📊 Analytics: Track pass/fail rates and time-to-completion.

🌍 Localization: Spanish, Arabic, German, French, and Hindi support.

🔗 LMS Integration: Sync data with your existing systems.

👥 Fleet Management: Deploy to hundreds of headsets instantly.

Contact GRAHAs VR for bulk licensing.
